Reason (R): The principal value branch of sin⁡−1x\sin^{-1}xsin−1x is [−π2,π2]\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right][−2π​,2π​] and that of sec⁡−1x\sec^{-1}xsec−1x is [0,π]−{π2}[0, \pi] - \left\{\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right\}[0,π]−{2π​}.

Tap the option you think is right.

Formula / idea Each principal value must lie in the range of its principal value branch.

    Find the three principal values.

    π3+π4−π4=π3\dfrac{\pi}{3} + \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}3π​+4π​−4π​=3π​π3+π4−π4=π3\displaystyle \dfrac{\pi}{3} + \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{\pi}{4} = \dfrac{\pi}{3}3π​+4π​−4π​=3π​

    A is false, so R cannot explain A.
